name: Sikafloor® Level Pro Primer
summary: High quality, pre-mixed latex liquid primer. Sikafloor® Level PRO Primer is a pre-mixed latex liquid designed for the priming of porous substrates prior to the use of Sikafloor® Cement based levelling products.
metaDescription:
High quality, pre-mixed latex liquid primer.

Sikafloor® Level PRO Primer is a pre-mixed latex liquid designed for the priming of porous substrates prior to the use of Sikafloor® Cement based levelling products.
attributes: Enhanced bond strength between concrete substrates & cement based products
Easy application - ready to use no mixing required
